profile.description: Oman International Development and Investment Company SAOG is a private equity firm specializing in buyout investments. The firm also seeks to invest in global capital markets and marketable securities. It seeks to invest in banking, Insurance, finance, leasing, financial services, commercial banking, investment banking, financial investments, real estate, tourism, technology, energy and industrial sectors. The firm also seeks to invest in steel, household products, aluminium, plastics, detergents, chemicals, tourism, and food products. It prefers to invest both locally and internationally. The firm prefers to invest in United States and Canada, Latin America and Caribbean, Europe, Asia/Pacific and Oman. The fund prefers to take majority stake in its portfolio companies. Oman International Development and Investment Company SAOG was founded in 1983 and is based in Muscat, Oman.
